claim: Fable-5 Skill Creation & Priority Roadmap: Six new consensus skills target Phase 0-1 stabilization: fable5-git-rebase-safety, fable5-tier-based-routing, fable5-mcp-diagnostics, fable5-endpoint-centralization, fable5-tool-cataloging, fable5-doc-layering. Phase 0 unblocks v2 multi-agent workflows (ranks 1-3, medium-small effort, existing foundations). Phase 1 hardens routing/catalog/docs (ranks 4-7, medium-large, triggers Phase 3 real-data-first gate). Phase 2 (concurrency coordination, telemetry aggregation) depends on Phase 0-1 solid. Top upgrade: model-routing-check skill gap (reachability vs actual router resolution), mcp-orchestration diagnostics subsection, hardware-policy timeout unification. Consensus: Architect + Reviewer + General + CodeGuide (highest-tier skill steering group).

decisions.notes: LLM Council session validated 6 new skills as highest-ROI for v2 unblocking (consensus 5-7 out of 7 panel members each). Tier-based-routing + git-rebase-safety + mcp-diagnostics form foundation layer; endpoint-centralization + tool-cataloging + doc-layering provide infrastructure. Current state: none of these exist as executable skills; they're documented patterns with partial implementation (frugality_router.py, reanchor_scan.sh, mcp_diagnostics.py in progress). Skills operationalize patterns, making them discoverable and actionable per CLAUDE.md horse-pulls-cart doctrine.
